rule: State changes composition, posture and object — not only a label (sprint §14).

estimate_and_archive.source: emphasis_map.ARCHIVED; composition_rules[3]; DISPATCH_TO_IFTA visual_transition (estimate badge, stone)

blocker.material: gold outline + solid marker, never alarm red

states.client_composition: No jacket on the desk. One explanatory threshold: what IFTA filing with AIO is, what you send, and SET UP IFTA FILING. Prerequisite link when no IFTA account.
states.staff_composition: Client row absent from queue; offer appears in client 360.
states.composition_emphasis: single explanatory threshold: what IFTA filing with AIO is + set up
states.client_meaning: Set up IFTA filing with AIO
states.staff_meaning: Client has no IFTA filing service

states.client_composition: Jacket open with three empty compartments drawn as dashed capture slots. Capture methods are the main content (TAKE PHOTO / UPLOAD / IMPORT FROM VAULT). Trucks shown pre-filled. Ring at 0 with champagne start mark.
states.staff_composition: Row: collection window open, nothing received · REMIND CLIENT.
states.composition_emphasis: empty packet with three compartments and the capture method picker
states.client_meaning: Your quarter is open — start sending fuel and miles

states.client_composition: Jacket open; active compartment on the bench; counts by class on each tab; the single next item leads the answer line; champagne progress line on the jacket spine.
states.staff_composition: Row: % of packet received · VIEW PROGRESS.
states.motion: ring fills; slips stack into the compartment
states.composition_emphasis: packet filling: compartments show counts and classes; next item leads

states.client_composition: A correction slip from AIO (gold rule, reviewer name, message) is clipped on top of the jacket; flags stack one at a time with the fix inline (1 of 2); compartments behind are dimmed; jacket outlined gold with a solid marker. CTA RESOLVE 2 ITEMS.
states.staff_composition: Row edge gold; AWAITING CLIENT — 2 RECEIPT CORRECTIONS · NUDGE CLIENT.
states.motion: resolved slip un-clips and drops into the compartment
states.composition_emphasis: flags lead: one card per flag with the fix inline; packet dimmed behind
states.client_meaning: A few items need you before AIO can review

states.client_composition: HELD posture plus a deadline strip across the desk (due in {d} days · {pct}%), remaining gaps ordered by impact. CTA FINISH QUARTER.
states.composition_emphasis: deadline banner over the packet; remaining gaps listed by impact
states.client_meaning: Due {due_date} — finish the quarter to avoid late filing

states.client_composition: Jacket closed with a silver band WITH AIO — JORDAN LEE. Capture tools removed. An AIO-at-work sheet beside it: what AIO is checking, started when, what happens next. CTA MESSAGE AIO.
states.staff_composition: Case opens on QUARTER_CASE + RECEIPT_CLASSES; START RECONCILIATION.
states.motion: silver band slides on when sent
states.composition_emphasis: inputs locked; who is reviewing + what happens next foregrounded

states.client_composition: Same closed jacket; AIO sheet shows fuel-to-miles matching by state in plain language. Calm, sparse.
states.staff_composition: Dense: reconciliation table state × truck, discrepancies with override + note; PREPARE RETURN SUMMARY.
states.composition_emphasis: client: calm progress; staff: jurisdiction × truck reconciliation table with discrepancies
states.client_meaning: AIO is matching fuel to miles

states.client_composition: The return summary sheet is laid on top of the closed jacket and fills the bench: totals, lines by state, AIO review status, material flags. One gold decision: APPROVE FOR FILING; ASK A QUESTION beside it. Receipts detail quiet.
states.staff_composition: Row: AWAITING CLIENT — return approval sent {date} · REMIND CLIENT.
states.composition_emphasis: decision window: the return summary is the object, approve / ask beside it

states.client_composition: Approved sheet clipped to the jacket; silver band reads FILING WITH {base jurisdiction}. CTA VIEW SUMMARY.
states.staff_composition: READY TO FILE: approved summary + confirmation entry; RECORD FILING CONFIRMATION.
states.composition_emphasis: approved summary with filing in progress
states.staff_meaning: Ready to file / filing in progress

states.client_composition: Workbench collapses: closed jacket with champagne seal on black, filed date, confirmation number, amount due / credit, payment status. The jacket travels along the Vault path (VAULT › TAX & FUEL › IFTA › 2026 › Q3). Next quarter jacket appears at the desk edge. CTA VIEW IN VAULT.
states.staff_composition: FILED / PAYMENT PENDING buckets; RECORD PAYMENT STATUS.
states.motion: seal stamps, jacket moves into the drawer
states.composition_emphasis: sealed quarter with confirmation; artifacts prominent; motion to the Vault

states.client_composition: Desk shows the next quarter as the bench object; the archived quarter is a stone jacket on the history shelf (one tap opens the sealed packet). CTA START Q{n+1} / open next quarter.
states.motion: archived jacket slides onto the shelf
states.composition_emphasis: history row in the filing room; next quarter becomes the bench object

states.client_composition: Correction notice (gold on black) over the summary: what the jurisdiction returned and what AIO is doing; explicit recovery copy. CTA MESSAGE AIO.
states.composition_emphasis: correction notice over the summary: what was returned and what AIO is doing
states.client_meaning: The jurisdiction returned your filing — AIO is correcting it
